articles.summary: Fellow Shareholders, Over the past several months, Lunai Bioworks (NASDAQ: LNAI) has continued to execute its strategy of building a next-generation biotechnology company at the intersection of artificial intelligence, and national security and biology. I would like to update you on developments that have substantially strengthened our position and created multiple pathways for shareholder value creation. A RARE STRATEGIC POSITION: THE NATIONAL SECURITY BIODEFENSE PLATFORM In April 2026, we secured our first revenue-generating, multi-year defense collaboration through BioSymetrics to deploy our AI-enabled platform for chemical threat assessment. This contract represents not a research relationship but an active commercial engagement with the U.S. government.
